name: @pipeworx/mcp-drugbank

tools.name: drugbank_ddi
tools.description: Check drug-drug interactions among a set of drugs. Returns curated interactions with severity, description, and management guidance. Accepts drug names or DrugBank IDs (comma-separated). Example: drugbank_ddi({ drugs: "warfarin, acetaminophen", _apiKey: "your-key" }) or drugbank_ddi({ drugs: "DB00682,DB00316", _apiKey: "your-key" })

drugs.description: Comma-separated list of drug names or DrugBank IDs to check against each other, e.g. "warfarin, aspirin" or "DB00682,DB00945".

_apiKey.description: DrugBank API key (commercial; trial keys at dev.drugbank.com).

tools.name: drugbank_drug_names
tools.description: Look up a drug by name or product. Resolves a query string to matching DrugBank drugs/products and their DrugBank IDs. Example: drugbank_drug_names({ query: "lipitor", _apiKey: "your-key" })

query.description: Drug or product name to search for, e.g. "lipitor", "atorvastatin".

_apiKey.description: DrugBank API key (commercial; trial keys at dev.drugbank.com).

tools.name: drugbank_drug
tools.description: Structured monograph (indication, MoA, dosing) for a drug. Returns indication, mechanism of action, dosages, and a summary of adverse effects for a single DrugBank drug. Example: drugbank_drug({ id: "DB00682", _apiKey: "your-key" })

id.description: DrugBank ID of the drug, e.g. "DB00682" (warfarin). Resolve names first via drugbank_drug_names.

_apiKey.description: DrugBank API key (commercial; trial keys at dev.drugbank.com).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-drugbank forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the drugbank pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
